Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: They have a site where you can select your courses and see if they dont overlap each other. Here you will see your full schedule

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: They have a course liste on their website where you can get an overview of all the available courses

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer:
Very successful! And if your don't enjoy the courses that you have selected you can change them within the first week of school. 

If you're unsure about a course, you can try it out and see if you like it before sticking to it

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Make a list of all the courses you find interesting... don't just find 4. The courses might overlap each other and then you can't choose them together. Some courses can be online or in the evening.... be aware of that too
